mentions.name: MPLS Coffee
mentions.description: This app shows the coffee shops nearest to the user. Each shop listing includes a Gemini AI overview describing the shop's offerings and other potentially useful information. It currently covers Minneapolis and Chicago.
mentions.source_excerpt: A simple coffee shop app that shows the nearest coffees shops that are closest to you. Using Google's AI, each shop has a Gemini AI overview that describes the shops offerings and other information that might be useful to the user.
